And in this year,
which is the year 1442
of the Greeks [1130/1131 AD],
the king of Jerusalem and Joscelin came from Edessa to Antioch to reign over it.
The Antiochenes, however, shut the gates in their faces,
until they swore that Antioch would be kept for the daughter of Bohemond until she grew up
and married a man,
and he would become the lord of Antioch.
And Amir Ghazi, son of Danishmend, entered Cilicia,
and captured fortresses {OCR?}.
Then Leon the Armenian humbled himself before him,
and swore
that he would no longer send raiders into his country,
and that he would pay him tribute every year.
And when he departed,
Leon lied,
and did not pay anything.
And Isaac {OCR?}, the brother of the emperor of the Greeks, went to Leon in Cilicia,
and he gave him his daughter as a wife,
and Mopsuestia and Adana as a dowry.
And afterwards a quarrel arose between them,
and Isaac and his son fled to Mas'ud, the sultan of Iconium.
And Joscelin died,
and Joscelin the Second reigned over Edessa.
And in this year, when Sultan Mahmud went out from Baghdad to go to Khorasan,
his brother Mas'ud came to him,
and humbled himself before him,
and carried before him the saddlecloth {OCR?: gashiyah},
that is, the covering of the saddle.
And they embraced one another,
and Sultan Mahmud surrendered to him lands and armies.
And he went to Hamadan,
and died there at the age of twenty-eight years.
Then they disputed with one another:
David, the son of Sultan Mahmud,
and two brothers of Mahmud himself,
Mas'ud and Seljuq Shah, sons of Muhammad {OCR?: Mahmud},
and Toghrul their brother,
the one who was with Malik Sanjar their uncle.
And they sent to the Caliph,
and each one of them sought the sultanate for himself.
The Caliph, however, was pleased with Sanjar at first,
and sent word to them:
"The one whom Malik Sanjar, the son of Sultan Malik Shah, desires,
and to whom he gives a letter of consent,
let him come to me and he shall be received."
And to Sanjar himself he sent word:
"We do not desire anyone besides you;
henceforth do not permit either of these two to take power."
